searchPlaceholder: Search a trip or a destination…

empty.hint: The next adventures are coming soon!

detail.deleteText: Registrations will be deleted and unpaid invoices cancelled. Not possible once payments were received.
detail.noProgram: The detailed program will be published soon.

form.programHint: One step per line: "08:00 | Departure" or "Day 1 | Settling in".
form.priceHint: 0 = free. An invoice is created for each registration.
form.monitorsHint: Choose the monitors in charge: they'll see the trip and take the roll-call.

kid.title: An adventure awaits!
kid.text: Show this trip to your parents: they can sign you up from their account.

flow.title: Trip registration
flow.chooseChild: Which child would you like to register?

reasonHint.closed: Registration isn't open for this trip.
reasonHint.deadline: The deadline has passed. Contact the team if needed.
reasonHint.tooYoung: This trip is for older children. Other adventures are coming soon!
reasonHint.tooOld: This trip is for younger children.

flow.fullHint: The trip is full: the registration will go on the waitlist.
flow.consentText: I allow {name} to take part in the "{title}" trip, group transport and planned activities, under the responsibility of ONET monitors. In an emergency, I allow the team to take the necessary measures.
flow.waitlistText: As soon as a place frees up, the registration moves forward automatically and you get notified.
flow.payText: The place is reserved. Pay the invoice online to confirm the registration.
flow.awaitingText: The team will confirm the registration very soon.
flow.confirmedTitle: It's confirmed: {name} is coming with us!

cancel.title: Cancel the registration?
cancel.text: The place will be freed and the unpaid invoice cancelled.
cancel.paidText: The place will be freed. The payment already made will be handled by the accounts team for a refund.

monitors.removeText: This monitor will no longer be in charge of the trip.
